description: Persistent Symphony lifecycle and recovery guard for Claude Code.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/env python3 -c "import pathlib,runpy,sys; r=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); p=r/'scripts'/'symphony_hook.py'; runpy.run_path(str(p if p.is_file() else max(r.parent.glob('*/scripts/symphony_hook.py'), key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime_ns)), run_name='__main__')" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
